messages:
sam: Noticing a spike in SSO failures from EU customers after last night's RBAC rollout. Errors look like signature verification and OIDC aud mismatches.

linda: Any logs? which IdP?

sam: Two snippets:

SAML signature error from authnproxy:
```
2026-06-10T22:05:12Z WARN saml_validator.go:87 signature verification failed: signature algorithm rsa-sha256 not found for key id k-2026-06-09
tenant=novum-corp relay_state=/app/login
```

OIDC token introspect from eeu region:
```
2026-06-10T22:07:01Z ERROR oidc_client.go:210 token validation failed: invalid_token_claim: aud mismatch (got: api://redwood, expected: redwood-internal)
sub=urn:oid:12345 tenant=novum-corp
```

tan: That aud mismatch smells like our RBAC switch changed the audience we ask IdP for. The token audience used to be `redwood-internal` but RBAC service now validates `api://redwood`. Or IdP mapping changed.

jess: We rolled a change that normalized role ids and also updated oauth client settings in staging -> prod last night. Could be the client registration got a different redirect/audience field. Ops-bot, show last oauth-client change.

ops-bot: [audit-log] oauth-client:update performed by @jess on 2026-06-10T03:18:22Z client_id=svc-redwood-web audience=["api://redwood"] previous_audience=["redwood-internal"] reason="align-audience-to-oidc-spec"

linda: Yep that's the culprit for aud. But why SAML sig errors? That key id looks like the KMS-backed signing key rotated. Ops-bot, KMS key rotation events?

ops-bot: [kms] key-rotation scheduled by @infra on 2026-06-09T23:59:00Z alias=alias/redwood/saml-signing old_key=key/k-2024 new_key=key/k-2026 status=Completed

sam: Some tenants use IdP-initiated SAML and verify our SP signature when we sign logout/request. If our signing key rotated but metadata not updated at partner IdP, verification fails.

tan: Two-prong plan: 1) revert oauth client audience while we coordinate with IdPs and RBAC, 2) publish rotated metadata and reach out to top 10 impacted tenants to update their IdP caches.

jess: Revert of audience is low-risk short-term rollback. I'll open a PR to change client back and push canary.

linda: For SAML: we should publish both old and new key ids in metadata for a transition window and enable signature verification fallback. Also add monitoring to alert when >1% of assertions fail verification.

sam: Customers also reported SCIM deprovisioning oddities: duplicate accounts created after a retry. Example from scim-sync log:
```
2026-06-10T22:15:44Z INFO scim_sync.go:412 deprov attempt -> remote 404, treating as success
tenant=brightlane user=svc-legacy-extid=ext-998
2026-06-10T22:15:46Z WARN scim_sync.go:460 create user because local state thought user existed but remote returned 404 -> created id=usr-884
```

tan: That's the old idempotency problem when externalId normalization changes (we used to lowercase+trim, new PR added strip-dashes). If the remote endpoint returned 404 during a transient outage, we create new user with normalized extid, ending up with duplication.

jess: Fix options: implement strong prewrite compare using hashed extid stored in envelope (so normalization mismatch won't duplicate), or add a compare-and-create transaction on remote using If-None-Match semantics. Which is faster?

linda: Short-term: add a retry/backoff that re-fetches by multiple extid normalizations before creating. Long-term: store canonical extid hash in envelope encrypted by KMS (so rewrap when key rotates).

ops-bot: [incident] INC-20260610-SSO-RBAC created by @sam severity=P2
links=[runbook/sso-rotation,statuspage/INC-20260610-SSO-RBAC]

sam: Owners: jess -> oauth client rollback, linda -> publish metadata and sig-fallback, tan -> scim dedupe hotfix, ops -> notify tenants + coordinate KMS rotation windows.

jess: Can ops confirm whether old saml signing key material is still available to publish dual-key metadata?

ops-bot: old-key material available until 2026-06-20T00:00:00Z per key-retention policy. Backup snapshot exists in secure key-vault.

linda: Nice. I'll draft a metadata change to include both KeyInfo entries and a small note for partners. Also will create an alert for signature failures.

tan: Working on a small scim patch that will check extid variants before create. Pushing to canary in 20m.

sam: Customer comms: I'll coordinate with CS to inform impacted tenants, incl. steps to refresh IdP metadata and temporary workaround (accept both keys).

jess: Rolled back oauth audience in canary. Monitoring shows OIDC aud errors dropped from 12/min to 0. Will promote to prod after 15m observation.

ops-bot: [deploy] oauth-client:revert applied by @jess at 2026-06-10T22:34:10Z

sam: Great. Keep this thread updated. After we get metadata dual-key published and scim dedupe in place we'll run a postmortem and update KMS rotation runbook to include rewrap/backwards-compat checks.

linda: Agreed. Postmortem owners: sam (incident), jess (deploy change), tan (scim bug), ops (kms runbook).

sam: Closing interim P2 once metrics stable. Will switch to follow-up task list.
